protected.label: Protected

srv.label: Forwarding to SRV
srv.description: Seeclub Stäfa is a member of the Swiss Rowing Federation SRV. As a member of the SCS you are automatically also a member of the SRV. The SRV requires us to forward personal information (last name, first name, postal address, phone number) of all our members. By becoming a member of the SCS you implicitly consent to this data being passed on to the SRV annually.
srv.srvemail: For sending the SRV News (formerly Swissrowing Magazine) the SRV needs your e-mail address. Here you have an opt-out option if you do not want to receive this news. In this case your e-mail will not be forwarded to the SRV at the next synchronization. You will then also no longer receive any news from the SRV.

both.label: both
both.description: can be either true or false

fog.label: Fog
fog.description: Fog, smoke, haze, Sahara dust, volcanic ash, etc.
